description: User completes the initial setup wizard (methods selected + optional grinder added). This is the top of the onboarding conversion funnel.
User taps Skip on the welcome step, bypassing the full setup wizard.
User saves a new brew log entry, including method, bean, dose, water, and brew time.
User saves tasting notes (attributes + flavors) for a brew log.
User manually adds a new coffee bean to their journal.
User scans a coffee bag label and saves the resulting bean entry via the scanner flow.
User adds a new brew method (from template or custom).
User taps Apply on an AI-generated brew suggestion banner when logging a brew.
User initiates a PDF or CSV export of their brew journal.
User navigates to the statistics dashboard — top of the engagement insight funnel.
User changes the app theme (light / dark / system) in Settings.
User starts the brew timer during a brew log session.
